## `ITopBarPage` { #itopbarpage-interface }

`public interface ITopBarPage`

A page that wears a top bar in a scaffold that uses `ForActivePage`. Pages that do not implement it get no bar and use the full height.

|---|---|

## `TopBars` { #topbars-static-class }

`public static class TopBars`

Ready-made slots for `NavigationScaffoldState.TopBar`.

**Methods**

| Member | Description |
|---|---|
| `static XenoComponent ForActivePage(NavigationPresentationContext context)` | Builds the bar of the active page from `ITopBarPage`: ```csharp new NavigationScaffoldState(...) { TopBar = TopBars.ForActivePage } ```  The scaffold rebuilds it when the active page changes; call `RebuildTopBar()` from a page when its title or actions change. |
